additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps CapabilityStatement in active build scope as a conformance resource and normative from 4.0.0. Current residual acceptUnknown hits are comments, inert rendering logic, historical release material, or QUICK.Conformance example content rather than a current CapabilityStatement element. A 2020 Zulip thread confirms implementers understood acceptUnknown had been removed in R4 and no replacement mechanism was identified in core.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml already omits CapabilityStatement.acceptUnknown and no active current CapabilityStatement instances contain the removed element.
